card.summary: A public-service prototype demonstrating accessible form design, conditional logic, custom PHP postcode validation and structured JSON service data.

caseStudy.overview: A portfolio mini lab exploring how a council-style digital service can collect meaningful information, validate submissions and expose structured data for internal use.
caseStudy.context: Created as practical evidence for a Digital Developer application, using fictional service data rather than a live council service.
caseStudy.problem: Design a clear public reporting journey that supports conditional questions, reliable postcode validation and structured downstream data.
caseStudy.challenge: Design a clear public reporting journey that supports conditional questions, reliable postcode validation and structured downstream data.
objectives: Create a structured public-service request form
Use conditional logic to reduce unnecessary questions
Validate postcode data on the server
Expose a fictional service-request record as structured JSON
approach: Built the public form with Drupal Webform
Used conditional logic to tailor the journey
Added a custom PHP postcode-validation module
Created a custom JSON endpoint for a fictional service request
caseStudy.solution: The prototype combines a conditional Drupal Webform, focused server-side validation and a structured JSON response so the same service request can support both public interaction and downstream internal processing.
accessibility: Used structured form fields and task-focused labels
Considered mobile, keyboard, low-digital-confidence and internal-staff personas
Final browser-based accessibility evidence is still being completed
testing: Verified valid and invalid postcode examples
Final WAVE, axe and keyboard evidence remains in progress
caseStudy.result: Working conditional service-request form, verified server-side postcode validation and structured fictional JSON response.
outcomes: Reusable portfolio evidence for digital-service development
limitations: Fictional portfolio prototype rather than a live council service
Not connected to a production case-management workflow
Final internal staff view and accessibility evidence are still being completed
nextSteps: Complete the internal staff case view
Refine the case study as the project is completed

accessibility: Structured form fields and task-focused labels; final browser-based accessibility evidence remains in progress.
testing: Verified valid and invalid postcode examples; final WAVE, axe and keyboard evidence remains in progress.
integration: Structured fictional JSON service-request response for internal use.
